description: This file defines the Slk class, a PHP implementation of a reader for SYLK (Symbolic Link) spreadsheet files as part of the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for validating, parsing, and loading SYLK files into PHPSpreadsheet objects, along with internal logic for handling cell data, styles, and worksheet information.

classes.name: Slk
classes.description: Implements a SYLK (Symbolic Link) file reader for PhpSpreadsheet. Handles validation, parsing, styling, and loading data from SYLK files into spreadsheet objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the Slk reader, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if a given file is a valid SYLK file by reading its header and analyzing its contents.

methods.name: listWorksheetInfo
methods.description: Provides basic worksheet metadata such as name, row count, and column details without fully loading the sheet.

methods.name: loadIntoExisting
methods.description: Loads the SYLK file data into an existing Spreadsheet object, creating sheets as needed.

methods.name: getSheetIndex
methods.description: Returns the current sheet index to read.

methods.name: setSheetIndex
methods.description: Sets the sheet index to be read from the SYLK file.
